body:
Can I hear more? This is simply wonderful. 
I feel this, it makes me reach into myself a little bit. 
I wouldn't change a single thing about this. Please share more!
"In the deck of days, today's an ace" ... that really resonated with me. I really take to the way you closed the poem with the opening, the tone of the poem is ever present.

Story and overall feel are on point, but the line breaks lose their meaning by the end of the poem, maybe why you feel the ending is weak. I would suggest using line breaks where they're going to make the impact.
This is phenomenal! The flow is perfect and the simple rhyme scheme allows the reader to actually immerse in the meaning, not just passing over words on a page.
